finding.summary: Default-timeout JavaScript interop creates a timeout CTS for every invocation.
finding.explanation: When DefaultAsyncTimeout is configured, every InvokeAsync call allocates a CancellationTokenSource and schedules a timeout timer before dispatching the interop operation. JS interop can be invoked frequently, but the actual call rate is application-dependent, so the source shape is classified likely rather than confirmed.

notes: Investigating runtime-owned default CTS independently of F096 public object-reference TimeSpan token constraints; no shipping edit or candidate presumed.
